# Zeely & GrowthBook | Introduction
Date: 2026-10-19 | Duration: 24.3700008392334m

## Summary
GrowthBook is currently used for feature flags and experiment results with BigQuery as the data source. Implementations are developer-managed, without a visual editor, and support product managers and analytics users; cloud hosting is preferred over self-hosting. The enterprise package includes SSO, SAML, SCIM provisioning, role-based access, direct team contact, training, onboarding, migration assistance, and BigQuery optimization tools focused on reducing costs, including a query optimization calculator and CDN usage. Pricing can be based on experiments or user seats, with unlimited platform access; examples include $500 per experiment or $1,000 per user yearly, with volume pricing available. Current BigQuery spend is $800 monthly, so positive ROI is required, although the optimization impact is unknown. GrowthBook is being evaluated as a Firebase Remote Config replacement, requiring setup-specific validation. A 14-day enterprise trial, technical documentation, and developer use-case review were proposed.

## Keywords
GrowthBook Enterprise, Firebase Remote Config, BigQuery optimisation, Feature flags, Experiment pricing, A/B testing
